title: All Tide Up | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located in the sought-after Seacrest area along scenic 30A, this newly built coastal retreat offers sweeping Gulf views and an elevated beachside experience just steps from public beach access. Thoughtfully designed with refined finishes and spacious living areas, the home blends luxury with relaxed coastal charm. The top-floor great room features vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings and abundant natural light, creating an inviting setting for gathering and entertaining. At the heart of the space, a chef-inspired kitchen showcases premium appliances, a large gas range, and dual waterfall islands that provide ample space for preparing meals and sharing memorable moments together. Outdoor living is designed for effortless relaxation, highlighted by a private resort-style pool and a beautifully appointed outdoor entertaining area complete with a kitchen, lounge seating, and dining space. Inside, multiple bedroom suites and a dedicated bunk room provide comfortable accommodations across three levels, all connected by a convenient elevator for easy access throughout the home. With a golf cart and bikes available for exploring nearby beach communities, as well as easy access to renowned dining, shopping, and attractions along 30A, this exceptional property offers a refined and memorable coastal escape.
